current_behavior_summary: file-budget.sh is a PreToolUse(Edit|Write) hook (FRAMEWORK_VERSION 2.2.0). It reads the JSON tool event from stdin via jq, derives PROJECT_ROOT from CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR or git toplevel, normalizes FILE_PATH to a repo-relative REL_PATH, and short-circuits with allow() for excluded classes: tests/spec dirs, test_/_test/conftest/.spec/.test names, docs (.md/.rst/.txt), config (.json/.yaml/.toml/.ini/.cfg/.conf/.env), generated (*_pb2.py/*.generated.*/*.min.*), migrations/alembic, and ALL plugins/vibeos/{hooks,scripts,agents,skills,decision-engine,reference,convergence} infra. It only enforces on recognized source extensions (.py/.ts/.tsx/.js/.jsx/.go/.rs/.java/.cs/.rb). For Write it counts proposed content lines; for Edit it uses current on-disk wc -l as a proxy. Two thresholds via env: FILE_BUDGET_WARN (default 250) -> allow_with_warning, FILE_BUDGET_MAX (default 300) -> deny. Response is the standard hookSpecificOutput JSON with permissionDecision allow|deny and a permissionDecisionReason. Notably .md files are EXPLICITLY EXCLUDED from file-budget, which is precisely the gap WO-128 doc-budget closes (doc COUNT, not per-file line size). Config shape: .vibeos/config.json today holds only {onboarding_complete, autonomy{level,negotiated_at,session_override}, features{agent_team_governance:true}} — NO anchor_terms/retired_terms/hygiene keys yet; those are net-new. Docs shape: 151 governed .md files total, 147 of them under docs/planning (heavily WO-NNN-*.md); only 2 at docs/ root (FILE-INVENTORY.md, USER-COMMUNICATION-CONTRACT.md), 1 in showcase, 1 in handoffs. generated-inventory.json (schema 1.0, fw 2.2.0, generated 2026-06-15) counts: 131 work_orders, 126 reference, 102 scripts, 35 tests, 32 agents, 20 hook_scripts, 15 claude_skills, 13 codex_skills, 10 decision_engine, 9 gates, 6 hooks, 5 convergence, 1 claude_workflow. CRITICAL pyramid finding: docs/FILE-INVENTORY.md is the de-facto pyramid manifest (it enumerates the canonical doc set thesis->anchor->PRD->spec->arch->plan), but the product-tier pyramid docs it names (docs/product/PRODUCT-ANCHOR.md, docs/product/PRD.md, docs/TECHNICAL-SPEC.md, docs/product/ARCHITECTURE-OUTLINE.md) DO NOT EXIST in this meta/plugin repo — VibeOS-plugin is the framework, not an instantiated VibeOS project. WO-INDEX.md has only 2 markdown links. This is why WO-128 must keep the pyramid root CONFIGURABLE and ship advisory until a real pyramid lands.

config_schema_spec.rationale: Single source of project config already read by test-quality-gate.sh and others via CONFIG_FILE="${PROJECT_DIR}/.vibeos/config.json" + jq -r. anchor_terms/retired_terms MUST be configurable per-project (master plan U6 line 153: 'not hardcoded product names') so the framework stays product-neutral.

anchor_terms.semantics: Allowed/expected product-vocabulary terms. Presence is normal; their ABSENCE across all governed docs is a soft signal the project may be drifting off-anchor (reported informationally, never blocking). Matching is case-insensitive, whole-token by default.

retired_terms.semantics: Deprecated/forbidden product vocabulary (old names, killed features, abandoned positioning). ANY occurrence in a governed doc is a drift finding. Each entry MAY be a plain string or an object {term, replacement, since} for actionable messaging.

match_mode.semantics: word = whole-token boundary match (\bTERM\b, case-insensitive); substring = naive contains; regex = each term compiled as an ERE. Default word avoids false positives on partial overlaps.

scan_globs.semantics: Which files are scanned for product-direction terms. Defaults to all governed markdown.

exclude_globs.semantics: Excluded from term scanning. Evidence/return packets legitimately quote retired terms (e.g. this packet) and would self-trip otherwise; WO files are historical record. Tunable per project.

enforcement_tier.semantics: advisory until the doc pyramid lands (master plan: 'Advisory tier until the doc pyramid lands, then blocking'). When blocking, retired-term hits cause exit 1; advisory always exits 0 and prints findings.

hygiene.note: Hygiene retention lives in a dedicated hygiene-policy.json (see script_specs) rather than inline here, to keep config.json operator-facing and policy machine-governed. config.json MAY carry only a pointer {hygiene:{policy_path:".vibeos/hygiene-policy.json"}}.

config_schema_spec.backward_compatibility: All keys optional with empty/permissive defaults. A config.json with no product_direction key => check exits 0 SKIP (nothing configured to enforce), exactly like file-budget allows when no relevant config. Do NOT mutate the existing autonomy/features keys.

script_specs.name: check-product-direction-drift.sh
script_specs.type: gate script (invoked by gate-runner.sh in the Fidelity/drift tier and optionally at session-start), NOT a PreToolUse hook
script_specs.conventions: #!/usr/bin/env bash; set -euo pipefail; FRAMEWORK_VERSION="2.2.0"; GATE_NAME="check-product-direction-drift"; SCRIPT_DIR/PROJECT_ROOT derivation identical to validate-development-plan-alignment.sh; logging [$GATE_NAME] PASS|FAIL|SKIP: message.
inputs: governed markdown files resolved from scan_globs minus exclude_globs
logic: 1. CONFIG_FILE="$PROJECT_ROOT/.vibeos/config.json"; if missing OR jq '.product_direction' is null/empty => echo SKIP, exit 0.

2. Read retired_terms (normalize: string|object -> term string + optional replacement). Read anchor_terms, match_mode (default word), scan_globs (default docs/**/*.md), exclude_globs, enforcement_tier (default advisory).
3. Build file list via find/globbing within PROJECT_ROOT, applying exclude_globs. Bash 3.2-safe (no globstar reliance: use find -name '*.md' -path filters).
4. For each retired term, grep -RniE (word boundary when match_mode=word) across the file list. Each hit => a finding {file, line, term, replacement?, message:"retired term 'X' present; use 'Y'"}.

5. anchor_terms: count files containing >=1 anchor term. If anchor_terms non-empty AND zero files match => emit a single informational finding 'no anchor terms present in governed docs (possible off-anchor drift)'. This is ALWAYS informational, never fails the gate.
6. Print a deterministic, sorted findings list (file:line:term).

7. Exit semantics: retired_terms_hits==0 => PASS exit 0. retired_terms_hits>0 AND enforcement_tier==advisory => print FAIL(advisory), exit 0 (gate-runner records as non-blocking). retired_terms_hits>0 AND enforcement_tier==blocking => FAIL, exit 1. Config/jq error or no config => SKIP exit 2 mapped to skip (mirror validate-development-plan-alignment.sh's 'exit 0 when plan absent' philosophy: absence of config is a skip, not a failure).

exit_codes.0: PASS (no retired terms) OR advisory findings present (non-blocking)
exit_codes.1: FAIL — retired terms present AND enforcement_tier == blocking
exit_codes.2: SKIP — no .product_direction config, or jq/parse error (treated as not-applicable)

script_specs.tier_integration: Registered in .claude/quality-gate-manifest.json under the Fidelity/drift tier with tier_blocking=false initially (advisory). Flip tier_blocking=true (or config enforcement_tier=blocking) when the doc pyramid exists. Mirrors gate-runner's existing advisory-vs-blocking handling (gate-runner.sh ~line 645 'tier_blocking' branch).
script_specs.must_not: Must not Write/Edit any doc; pure read + report. Must not delete. Must not hardcode any product name (all terms come from config).

script_specs.name: hygiene-policy.json
script_specs.proposed_path: .vibeos/hygiene-policy.json (project-governed) with a shipped default template at plugins/vibeos/reference/hygiene/hygiene-policy.default.json
script_specs.type: machine-governed retention policy file (data, not script)
script_specs.rationale: Master plan U7 line 154: 'retention policy for checkpoints/exhaust'. Today .vibeos/checkpoints/ is empty and there is no exhaust accumulation yet — the plan explicitly says this is the right time to install the policy BEFORE sprawl, since the problem is smaller than Joan4U's 8,600-dir exhaust.

checkpoints.semantics: Retain the most recent keep_last_n OR anything newer than max_age_days, whichever set is larger; never prune below min_keep regardless of age.

observation_exhaust.semantics: Transient run-exhaust (hook event logs, night-loop reports, loop history). Pruned more aggressively than checkpoints.

archive.semantics: Before any --execute deletion, pruned artifacts are moved (git mv) into archive_dir and committed, so deletion is always recoverable from git history. mode=git is the only supported mode in v1 (master plan: 'git-backed archive').

doc_budget.semantics: Per-project ceiling on governed-doc COUNT (complements file-budget.sh which governs per-file LINE count and explicitly excludes .md). Current repo: 151 governed md (4 under evidence-excluded would adjust); warn at 160, ceiling at 200, both advisory initially.

script_specs.exit_dryrun_semantics: Not executable; consumed by prune-observation-exhaust.sh and (for doc_budget) by check-doc-budget.sh. Validation: a schema-validate step (jq presence + type checks) should run in the existing JSON quality gate so a malformed policy is caught at commit boundary.
script_specs.must_not: This lane does NOT create this file (prohibited path .vibeos/**); it only specifies the schema. Implementation WO writes the default template under plugins/vibeos/reference and instantiates .vibeos/hygiene-policy.json during discover/plan.

script_specs.name: prune-observation-exhaust.sh
script_specs.type: utility script (operator-invoked / autonomy-invoked), NEVER a hook
script_specs.conventions: #!/usr/bin/env bash; set -euo pipefail; FRAMEWORK_VERSION="2.2.0"; reuses gate-runner's --dry-run flag idiom (gate-runner.sh already has DRY_RUN handling).

dry_run_contract.default_mode: DRY-RUN IS MANDATORY DEFAULT. Running with no flags performs a full plan-only pass: it computes the prune set, prints exactly which files/dirs WOULD be archived+deleted, prints retained set, prints a summary count, and EXITS 0 having modified NOTHING on disk.
execute_preconditions: git working tree must be clean if archive.require_clean_git_for_execute is true (refuse with exit 2 otherwise).

For every artifact to prune: git mv it into archive.archive_dir preserving relative path, THEN git commit the archive move ('hygiene: archive pruned exhaust per hygiene-policy'). Deletion == archival move, so the bytes survive in git history and the working tree.
No artifact below min_keep is ever touched, even with --execute.
dry_run_contract.output_shape: Deterministic, sorted: 'WOULD ARCHIVE: <path> (age Nd, rank K/total)', 'RETAIN: <path> (reason: within keep_last_n | newer than max_age_days | min_keep floor)', then 'SUMMARY: would_prune=N retain=M scope=...'. With --execute the same lines but 'ARCHIVED:' and a trailing 'COMMIT: <sha>'.
dry_run_contract.idempotency: Re-running dry-run after an --execute run yields would_prune=0 (already pruned).

exit_codes.1: --execute attempted but a git operation failed (mv/commit) — partial state reported, safe to re-run
exit_codes.2: Refused: missing/invalid policy, OR --execute with dirty git tree when require_clean_git_for_execute is true

script_specs.must_not: MUST NOT delete with plain rm. MUST NOT delete without --execute. MUST NOT delete without first archiving to git. MUST NOT prune anything outside the policy's enumerated paths. No interactive prompts (bash non-interactive constraint).

doc_budget_ceiling.rule: Count governed docs matching doc_budget.scan_globs minus exclude_globs. If count > max_governed_docs => advisory finding 'doc budget exceeded: N > MAX'. If count > warn_governed_docs => advisory warning. Surfaced as an advisory gate finding, never blocking initially (mirrors the advisory-until-pyramid posture). This complements file-budget.sh: file-budget governs per-file LINE size and EXPLICITLY excludes .md; doc-budget governs project-wide doc COUNT. Same budget-hook shape, orthogonal axis.
doc_budget_ceiling.current_repo_reading: 151 governed md (docs/**/*.md); with default exclude docs/evidence/** removed, governed-doc count is ~150 (4 evidence md exist but most evidence is .json). At warn=160/max=200 the repo is currently UNDER budget, which is the correct steady state — the ceiling is a tripwire for the 700-doc drift class, not a fail today.
doc_budget_ceiling.implemented_by: check-doc-budget.sh (proposed plugins/vibeos/scripts/check-doc-budget.sh) reading hygiene-policy.json .doc_budget. Exit 0 always in advisory tier; exit 1 only when promoted to blocking AND over max.

orphan_reachability_rule.rule: A governed doc is REACHABLE if it is the pyramid root (doc_budget.pyramid_index, default docs/FILE-INVENTORY.md) OR is linked (transitively) from the root via markdown links/path references. Build a reachability set by BFS from the root: parse each reachable doc for (a) markdown links [text](path), (b) bare relative .md path mentions, (c) for index-style docs, glob patterns like docs/planning/WO-NNN-*.md that the root explicitly authorizes (FILE-INVENTORY.md uses the WO-NNN-*.md wildcard form — the resolver MUST expand documented wildcards or every WO file would be a false-positive orphan). Any governed doc NOT in the reachability set is an ORPHAN => advisory finding 'orphan doc: <path> not reachable from <pyramid_index>'.
orphan_reachability_rule.config_dependency: pyramid_index is configurable (hygiene-policy.json). Because this meta-repo's product-tier pyramid docs (docs/product/PRODUCT-ANCHOR.md etc.) do NOT exist, the detector must tolerate a missing pyramid root by SKIPPING (exit 2) rather than declaring all 151 docs orphans. That graceful-skip is itself part of the 'advisory until the doc pyramid lands' contract.
orphan_reachability_rule.wildcard_handling: FILE-INVENTORY.md authorizes docs/planning/WO-NNN-*.md as a class. The resolver expands any '*'/'NNN' wildcard token in a documented path into the matching glob so the 147 WO files count as reachable. Without this, orphan detection would be uselessly noisy on this repo.

risks: R1 Pyramid root absent in meta-repo: VibeOS-plugin has no docs/product/*.md pyramid tier (FILE-INVENTORY.md documents them but they are not instantiated here). Orphan detection MUST graceful-skip (exit 2) on missing root, else it flags all 151 docs. Mitigation baked into orphan_reachability_rule.

R2 Wildcard reachability: FILE-INVENTORY.md authorizes docs/planning/WO-NNN-*.md as a wildcard. If the resolver does literal-path matching only, all 147 WO files become false-positive orphans. Mitigation: documented-wildcard expansion (specified).

R3 Self-tripping lint: evidence/return packets (including THIS file) legitimately quote retired-term examples ('OldProductName'). Default exclude_globs must cover docs/evidence/** or the lint flags its own evidence. Specified in exclude_globs.

R4 Advisory->blocking flip risk: promoting enforcement_tier to blocking before a real pyramid exists would hard-block commits. The tier gate MUST stay advisory until a discover/plan step writes the pyramid; tie the flip to pyramid-presence, not a date.

R5 Prune safety: any deviation from archive-then-delete (e.g. a future --force path, or rm fallback) reintroduces the data-loss risk WO-128 exists to prevent. The dry-run-default + git-archive contract must be enforced by a test that asserts default mode changes zero bytes on disk.

R6 config.json schema additivity: product_direction is net-new; the writer must MERGE into existing config (preserve autonomy/features) not overwrite. Out of scope here but a real implementation hazard.

R7 Doc-budget false economy: counting docs/planning/WO-*.md (147 files) toward a 200 ceiling means normal WO growth could trip the budget within ~50 more WOs. Consider excluding WO-NNN-*.md from the budget count (they are generated/governed records) or raising the ceiling. Flagged for the implementing WO to decide; default exclude currently only removes evidence.

defects_found.finding: FILE-INVENTORY.md lists product-pyramid docs (docs/product/PRODUCT-ANCHOR.md, docs/product/PRD.md, docs/TECHNICAL-SPEC.md, docs/product/ARCHITECTURE-OUTLINE.md, docs/ENGINEERING-PRINCIPLES.md, etc.) as files the plugin creates, but they do not exist in this repo. This is EXPECTED for a meta/framework repo (these are created in downstream instantiated projects), not a defect in the plugin — but it is the concrete reason WO-128's pyramid root and enforcement tier must be configurable and advisory-by-default. Documented here so the implementing WO does not assume a live pyramid exists.
